scope: User-requested re-audit of committed work by another agent: typed client descriptors and presentation (commit b245eb5, excluding the model-extension-slot work also in it) and the form controller, React/Vue adapters and database startup logging (commit cac1ccf)
distribution: Local changes only; no commit, push, tag, publication or starter dependency update performed

environment.tools: Existing pinned bin/gopls, native Node v24.21.0 and the project TypeScript compiler with the previously approved React/React DOM/Vue/jsdom development dependencies
environment.data: Existing private test configuration read without printing it; no database reset/drop, shared-store flush or new server

baseline_gates.note: The baseline gates passed; the findings below were found by source review and reproduced by new regression tests.

findings.finding: Any edit or reset aborted an in-flight submission and a completed request returned 'stale' without its value, hiding a server outcome (AGENTS.md: never turn unknown outcomes into definite rollback).
findings.regression: forms.mjs late completion, failure after edit, dispose, stream ownership and outcome cases

findings.finding: Runs aborted while debouncing kept their capacity slot until a later microtask, so re-running three or more tasks from one handler threw form_task_busy.
Maps keyed by model IDs could not be navigated: .field(id) compiled but threw, .at/.element did not compile.
findings.regression: descriptors/types.ts and runtime.mjs OwnerIndex cases (new schema-only fixture DTO)

findings.finding: .at(key) accepted keys the codec rejects (enum cases, integer syntax, model IDs) and indexes beyond a fixed array length.
findings.disposition: fixed by reusing the codec's map-key rules (WireCodec.mapKey)

findings.finding: Built-in number/boolean parsing accepted surrounding whitespace and the text null, contradicting the guide.
The input-only password rule ran only in manifest normalization, i.e. only when clients were exported.
findings.disposition: fixed at route registration for JSON and event-stream responses (user decision); notification, table, presence and realtime outputs remain checked at contract export

findings.finding: Password hints were accepted on path/query/realtime room parameters.
findings.disposition: fixed in http declarations/registration and manifest validation (user decision); form and multipart body fields remain valid
findings.regression: http and manifest URL credential cases

findings.finding: Choices were decoded eagerly on every navigation with a linear membership check per case.
findings.disposition: fixed: decoded once per type and shared frozen

findings.finding: Edits aborted tasks before storing new values, so an abort listener restarting a task used the old values with the new revision.
A signal-like object without listener methods left the busy guard set until dispose.
findings.disposition: fixed: signals are validated before the guard; the guard is released first in finally

findings.finding: Server rendering never stops component scopes, so each SSR render left a subscription on a borrowed store.
findings.regression: form_adapters/runtime.mjs SSR and stopped-scope subscription counts

findings.finding: Published as 256 while keys were capped at 128 by message-key validation; tests used 257.
findings.regression: contract key boundary test; generator oversized key case

findings.finding: Enum and transport-field contradictions passed generation and failed at registration with an unnamed generic error.
findings.disposition: fixed: generation diagnostics for enum and plain scalar transport fields (checked after enum discovery); registration errors name the type/field or parameter

findings.finding: Repeated parameters/parts lost their element hint under Each rules and a comparison's other label was never compared.
findings.regression: manifest repeated element and compare cases (mutation-checked)

findings.finding: Copied rule IDs, a hand-maintained TypeScript kind union, a duplicated freeze helper and a descriptor loader without the manifest version check.
findings.disposition: fixed: validation.EmailRuleID/URLRuleID, contract.PresentationKinds with generated PresentationKind, shared immutable and loadRuntimeDocument
findings.regression: contract kind-set ownership test; existing consumer suites

findings.finding: Two descriptor assertions could not fail; OpenAPI presentation on path/query/form/multipart inputs was untested.
findings.disposition: fixed; OpenAPI also placed repeated inputs' hints on the array and now places them on items. Two other claimed-vacuous tests (contract snapshot, http parameter snapshot) and the presentation_parameter_owner compile-fail case were checked and kept: they do guard slice ownership and owner-type preservation.

findings.finding: A tracked guide depended on an untracked private .cache patch.
findings.disposition: fixed: reworded as private and to be re-derived; adoption steps include the new submit outcomes

clean_areas: Database startup logging: logs role/attempt/timing/classification only, never connection strings or driver text; handlers isolated through internal/callback; logger binding frozen once start is attempted; retry and timeout behavior unchanged; tests cover redaction, panic/Goexit and module binding

Descriptor lookups use Map/find (prototype keys rejected); JSON Pointer escaping matches Go; omitted/null/zero stay distinct; React snapshots are stable; the core SDK imports no UI package; manifest password reachability, determinism and version checks are sound
not_changed: A response that fails its own contract after the server processed the request still surfaces as a request-level failure; distinguishing it needs a new SDK error type.
A JSON body whose root is a union, array or map has no root descriptor (documented).
Any edit invalidates every task's result, including unrelated option lists (existing design).
Commit messages of b245eb5 and cac1ccf do not describe their contents; they are pushed, so history was not rewritten.

source_identity.note: shasum -a 256 over the changed and new non-documentation files relative to cac1ccf, in sorted order; none was modified after the final verify

checks.targeted: go test for contract, http, openapi, internal/generate, validation, typescript, internal/identifier and i18n; clientcontracts with TypeScript required; three manifest mutations (URL password, repeated element, compare label) each caught by the new tests

typescript.note: Real HTTP/WebSocket TypeScript consumers and the React/Vue adapter runtime, in required mode

test_postgres.result: 265 packages passed; five consumer packages failed to build because files vanished from the shared ~/Library/Caches/go-build mid-run (the whole cache was cleared at 18:13:49 by a process outside this session, as at 14:11 earlier). No test failed.

test_postgres_resumed.result: tenantqueries, timequeries, tooling, transactionqueries, upsertqueries, validationinput, validationrules and windowqueries passed; the rest have no tests. With the 265 above, all 273 packages passed.

decision: All confirmed findings fixed with regression tests and the full gates pass on the corrected source. The descriptor and form slices remain accepted; their earlier evidence records predate these corrections.
